card.name: Linking words inside work titles
card.fires_on: A joining word or punctuation mark in the middle or at the end of a book, journal or episode title, such as 'and', 'to', 'at', a comma, a bracket or a question mark. The title is named in running web text, often with a year or publisher nearby.

modes.label: Word inside a title
modes.description: A small word like and, at or to partway through a title of a book, journal or show.

modes.label: Punctuation after a title
modes.description: A comma, bracket or question mark that closes the title and leads to publication details.
